name: Warm interiors and Japan
description: Calm lived-in rooms, mid-century and Japanese interiors, plus ukiyo-e and soft painted landscapes in muted earth tones with one cool accent.
light: soft window daylight or warm lamp light, long gentle shadows, wood-toned glow
composition: eye-level view into a room or landscape, window or doorway as a frame, balanced asymmetry, generous empty floor or sky
camera_or_medium: architectural photography (35mm, natural light) or Japanese woodblock and gouache-style illustration
texture_detail: natural materials (wood grain, tatami, linen, stone), paper texture on illustrations, restrained decor
